column4: Accept with revisions because E1–E6 support an independently valuable attribution study, while candidate.json's unnecessary interaction requirement creates one repairable MAJOR that blocks Strong Accept; completion requires restricting that falsifier to an explicitly identity-sensitive hypothesis and specifying how the existing position-matched and randomized-inspection contrasts distinguish the broader proposed pathway from E3, including the identity-insensitive counterexample, within the stated scope and budget.
